dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I ask what you were considering?

dialogues.speaker: Veleda
dialogues.text: Of course you can. I was wondering how humanity came about.

dialogues.speaker: Veleda
dialogues.text: We Melusines were born of Elynas. So I've often been wondering — how did the first human in this world come to be?

dialogues.speaker: Veleda
dialogues.text: Were they born from flesh and blood like we were? Or were they created in some other way?
